verdict.rationale: Open-sourcing is a fair question for a SaaS bookkeeping product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack shows Kick publishing its source code or offering any open license. The OpenAPI fragments embedded in the GitBook API reference, and the agent-readable docs (llms.txt), are documentation surfaces, not product source under an open license.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
